claim: Bem1 directly augments the guanine exchange factor (GEF) activity of Cdc24.
source: Here, we find that Bem1 directly augments the guanine exchange factor (GEF) activity of Cdc24.
evidence: This claim is supported by in vitro reconstitution experiments showing that Bem1 increases the rate of Cdc24 GEF activity towards Cdc42, as demonstrated in Figure 1A and 1B.

claim: Bem1 increases GEF phosphorylation by the p21-activated kinase (PAK), Cla4.
source: Bem1 also increases GEF phosphorylation by the p21-activated kinase (PAK), Cla4.

claim: Phosphorylation abrogates the scaffold-dependent stimulation of GEF activity, rendering Cdc24 insensitive to additional Bem1.
source: Phosphorylation abrogates the scaffold-dependent stimulation of GEF activity, rendering Cdc24 insensitive to additional Bem1.
evidence: This claim is supported by GEF activity assays shown in Figure 1E demonstrating that phosphorylated Cdc24 is resistant to Bem1 stimulation.

claim: Bem1 stimulates GEF activity in a reversible fashion, contributing to signalling flux through Cdc42.
source: Thus, Bem1 stimulates GEF activity in a reversible fashion, contributing to signalling flux through Cdc42.
evidence: This claim is inferred from the combined observations that Bem1 stimulates GEF activity and also promotes phosphorylation that inhibits this stimulation.

claim: Active Cdc42 was enriched at the cell pole in hypophosphorylated cdc24 mutants.
source: The contribution of Bem1 to GTPase dynamics was borne-out by in vivo imaging: active Cdc42 was enriched at the cell pole in hypophosphorylated cdc24 mutants
evidence: This claim is supported by in vivo imaging data shown in Figure 3C and 3D demonstrating increased Cdc42 and Cdc42 GTP reporter at the pole in cdc24-46A mutants.

claim: Hyperphosphorylated cdc24 mutants that were resistant to scaffold stimulation displayed a deficit in active Cdc42 at the pole.
source: while hyperphosphorylated cdc24 mutants that were resistant to scaffold stimulation displayed a deficit in active Cdc42 at the pole.
evidence: This claim is supported by in vivo imaging data shown in Figure 3D demonstrating reduced Cdc42 GTP reporter at the pole in cdc24-28D mutants.

claim: Scaffold proteins modulate signalling pathway activity spatially and temporally.
source: Scaffold proteins modulate signalling pathway activity spatially and temporally.
evidence: This claim draws from established scientific consensus about scaffold protein function.

claim: The scaffold Bem1 contributes to polarity axis establishment by regulating the GTPase Cdc42 in budding yeast.
source: In budding yeast, the scaffold Bem1 contributes to polarity axis establishment by regulating the GTPase Cdc42.

claim: Cdc42 is activated at a specific site on the plasma membrane by the GEF Cdc24 early in the cell cycle.

claim: Bem1 might constitute part of a positive feedback loop where activated Cdc42 could bind Bem1, recruiting the GEF to activate additional Cdc42.
